entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-08
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Possibly erroneous InvalidOperationException with property owned by entity and nested entity. #38255
  • Add Frozen Collections #38382
  • EF1003: Also detect explicit calls to string.Format(...) and string.Concat(...) #37915
    11.0.0
  • Query: Translate List.Exists #17762
    11.0.0
  • List.Contains cause duplicate parameters #38383

Updated

  • ComplexProperty ToJson(): SaveChangesAsync throws 'ordinal -1 is invalid' when nested sub-collection grows (2+ JSON columns) #38299
    10.0.10
  • NullReferenceException from ChangeTracker when using HasDiscriminator() #38096
    11.0.0
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.SqliteException (0x80004005): SQLite Error 14: 'unable to open database file' #34273
    Backlog
  • `PublishAot` + `EFOptimizeContext` fork bombs the system #38087
  • Error when generating a new migration with SqlVector in EF 10 #38162
    11.0.0
  • Old migration break in EF Core 8 that worked in EF Core 7 and previous #33734
    11.0.0
  • Improve exception message for tracking multiple nested owned entities sharing same instance #31540
    Backlog
  • Consider EF support (if any) for the upcoming C# discriminated unions #36375
    Backlog
  • Allow opt-out of optimistic concurrency/rows affected check in the model #10443
    Backlog
  • GroupBy with SelectMany and Take() - The LINQ expression could not be translated #28002
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Guard EF file generation against design-time builds to fix AOT build fork bomb #38386

Merged

  • Pin GitHub workflow actions to immutable commit SHAs #38385
  • EF1003: Detect explicit string.Format/string.Concat in raw SQL APIs #38208
    community-contribution
  • Translate List<T>.Exists to Queryable.Any #38226
    community-contribution
  • Make DateTime.Parse translation tests culture-invariant #38384
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38379
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38380

Updated

  • Render TVP type name correctly in ToQueryString for SQL Server #38251
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix 'ordinal -1 is invalid' crash when a nested JSON complex sub-collection grows #38373
  • Simplify SQL Server DROP DEFAULT CONSTRAINT migration query #38250
    community-contribution
  • Fix: Cosmos ToList on structural collection is treated as scalar #38122
    community-contribution
